songs.title: Open My Heart's Eyes
songs.matchNotes: Justin's original. Not the Paul Baloche song Open the Eyes of My Heart. Lyric PDF copied as-is from AL album files (Flourish lyrics shared PDF). Album lead sheet exists in Db (and Eb when paired with Be Thou My Vision) — not used, wrong key and lead-sheet format. No official recording; YouTube left blank. Do not use demo/scratch audio or the album site.

audio.label: Rough mix (Nov 8), not final. Recorded in the album key: Db. Tonight we play it in A.
